questions_for_mark.question: Where the comms console goes
questions_for_mark.recommendation: Spot A, ship (-11.0, 8.0): 9.9 m from the chair, faces the bow, under the wall's clocks and signal screens; B (-5.6, 7.0) 5.8 m but a desk on the open stage; C leave it (the monitors carry the glance, but it faces the rim)

questions_for_mark.question: The wall's axis
questions_for_mark.recommendation: ship time (the spacing is the Earth-rate history)

questions_for_mark.question: Out-of-beam light
questions_for_mark.recommendation: show it as static on the film

questions_for_mark.question: What the waterfall hears
questions_for_mark.recommendation: the whole signal (True beacon + the week's bed) on the silent tap whenever in beam and on screen; the bracket measured on the carrier alone

questions_for_mark.question: The carrier beyond hearing
questions_for_mark.recommendation: True only for now (dark band + 'above hearing' arrow); a labelled Processed wideband view later, own design

questions_for_mark.question: Stamp precision
questions_for_mark.recommendation: one record per ship day (bounded log)

questions_for_mark.question: Which ambient screens
questions_for_mark.recommendation: four: signal from home, Earth vs ship clocks, course, crew; fold the beam strip into the signal screen and the console; dust/ISM and the exposure meter later

questions_for_mark.question: Where the screens go
questions_for_mark.recommendation: wall R: the bow rail at r 21.1 m outside the walk, bearings -48/-30/+30/+48, 4.0 x 2.25 m, camera occluders; every evaluator metric unchanged (W and F failed as tried)

questions_for_mark.question: A stern repeater for the Astern view
questions_for_mark.recommendation: not in this sprint; the deck-layout-after-camera pass

questions_for_mark.question: The screens' look
questions_for_mark.recommendation: Blender-authored grown frames (D-104) in CV4's generator run

questions_for_mark.question: Remaining ship time on the course screen
questions_for_mark.recommendation: add the sim field journey.ship_years_left (D-21: no computing it in Godot)
